tools.name: search_vehicle_knowledge
tools.description: Search public KentekenKompas model, answer, term and provenance knowledge using deterministic lexical relevance. relevanceScore is not AI-confidence.

tools.name: get_model_context
tools.description: Get validated public context for one exact modelKey; this is model-level knowledge, not an assessment of an individual vehicle.

tools.name: get_answer_context
tools.description: Get one existing KentekenKompas Direct Answer by stable answerId without generating new text.

tools.name: compare_vehicle_models
tools.description: Return the existing validated relation between two exact modelKeys; a relation is not automatically a direct alternative.

tools.name: explain_dutch_vehicle_term
tools.description: Explain one existing Dutch vehicle term using an exact term key or supported normalized term form; no fuzzy generation.

tools.name: get_source_context
tools.description: Get one exact public SOURCE or SOURCE_GROUP. Composite-looking source IDs are opaque and are never split.

tools.name: get_fuel_price_context
tools.description: Get validated fuel-price source status and limitations; never invents a current price.
